ui.collectionSubtitle: Make your icons part of the landscape.
ui.autostartTitle: Run Deskland automatically when you sign in
ui.autostartBlocked: Start with Windows may have been blocked
ui.autostartWarnSw: Deskland didn't start automatically this time — {sw} may have blocked it. Open {sw}, find Deskland in its startup manager and set it to Allow.
ui.autostartWarnGeneric: Deskland didn't start automatically this time — your security software or the Windows Startup apps setting may have blocked it. Turn Deskland on in your security software's startup manager, or in Windows Settings → Apps → Startup.
ui.updateVersion: Deskland {version} is ready. Your current theme and settings will be kept.
ui.updateCompleted: The update has been downloaded and installed. If Deskland does not restart automatically, open it again.
ui.updateCanceled: The update was canceled. You can try again later.
ui.updateLowBattery: The update could not finish on battery power. Plug in your device and try again.
ui.updateWifiRecommended: This network may incur charges. Switch networks or try again later.
ui.updateWifiRequired: Connect to Wi-Fi to download this update.
ui.updateStoreRequired: This update method is only available in the Microsoft Store edition.
ui.updateFailed: The update failed. Check your connection or Microsoft Store and try again.
ui.updateChecking: Connecting to the update server and checking for a new version…
ui.networkTimeout: The connection or download timed out. Check your network, proxy or firewall and try again. If other websites work, the server may also be responding slowly.
ui.networkDns: The server address couldn't be resolved. Check your network, DNS or proxy settings and try again.
ui.networkTls: A secure connection couldn't be established. Check the system time and any security interception by your network or proxy, then try again.
ui.networkLocal: The network connection failed or was interrupted. Check your network, proxy or firewall and try again.
ui.serverUnavailable: The server was reached, but the service is temporarily unavailable (HTTP 5xx). Please try again later.
ui.serverRejected: The server rejected the request (HTTP 4xx). Try again later or contact support if this continues.
ui.serverInvalid: The server returned an unrecognized response. Try again later or contact support if this continues.
ui.downloadInvalid: The download was incomplete or failed security verification, so installation was stopped. Try again or contact support if this keeps happening.
ui.previewIcons: Live preview · using the {n} icons on your desktop
ui.previewNoIcons: Live preview · desktop icons are hidden
ui.refreshTitle: Generate a new scene for this theme
ui.shareImageTitle: Share your desktop image while protecting your privacy
ui.shareVideoTitle: Share your desktop animation while protecting your privacy
ui.sharePrivacy: Icons are replaced with sample icons and file names with color blocks, so none of your files are shown.
ui.shareCopiedImage: The image is on your clipboard — paste it straight into a chat or a post.
ui.shareCopiedVideo: The video file is on your clipboard — paste it into a chat window to send it.
ui.autosave: Changes are saved automatically and applied to your desktop right away
ui.resetAllTitle: Reset all settings of this theme to their defaults
ui.helpWallpaperQ: Deskland keeps flickering or restarting. How do I fix it?
ui.helpWallpaperA: If your regular Windows wallpaper changes automatically, each change can make Deskland flicker or restart. Use a fixed background that does not rotate.
ui.helpWallpaperStep2: Set ‘Personalize your background’ to ‘Picture’ or ‘Solid color’. Do not use ‘Slideshow’ or ‘Windows spotlight’.
ui.helpWallpaperStep3: Restart Deskland after changing this setting.
ui.lockedTitle: {name} · Wallpaper edition theme; click for purchase details
ui.purchaseLocalTheme: “{name}” is included in the Wallpaper edition.
ui.purchaseLocalMessage: After you buy from the current store, Deskland verifies your purchase and unlocks it automatically—no account sign-in needed. If you just bought it, check again.
ui.ongoingDesc: New scenes and elements will be added over time.
ui.noParams: This theme has no settings yet
ui.purchaseTheme: “{name}” is included in the Wallpaper edition.
ui.purchaseMessage: The preview includes Beach and Meadow forever. Get the Wallpaper edition to unlock more themes in the same Deskland app.

host.welcomeBody:
Click the beach icon in the system tray{hotkey} to open the menu.
Can't see it? Click ^ on the right side of the taskbar.
host.errBusyImage: The previous image is still being generated
host.errBusyVideo: The previous clip is still recording
host.errRebuilt: Windows kept rebuilding the wallpaper layer, so Deskland has stopped.
host.errNoDesktop: Couldn't find the desktop window, so the wallpaper can't be attached.

lotus.name: Lotus Pond
lotus.desc: Lotus leaves and blossoms fill the pond, with koi swimming between the leaves and icons and leaving ripples

density.label: Lotus leaf density
density.hint: How much of the water is covered by leaves; 100% is the original density, 0 hides leaves and their flowers

sigma.label: Open water
sigma.hint: How much open water surrounds your icons

fish.label: Koi
fish.hint: Koi swimming between lotus leaves and icons

flowers.label: Lotus flowers
flowers.hint: The amount of lotus blossoms, buds and water lilies

lake.name: Lake
lake.desc: Watercolor grass surrounds a clear lake, with painted stones beneath the shallows and crisp reflections of puffy clouds

sigma.label: Grassy shore
sigma.hint: How far the grassy banks extend from your icons

shoal.label: Clear shallows
shoal.hint: How far the underwater stones remain visible from the shore

depth.label: Water depth
depth.hint: The distance from turquoise blue shallows to teal deeper water

flow.label: Water movement
flow.hint: The speed of gentle ripples, shimmering light and cloud reflections

clouds.label: Cloud count
clouds.hint: The number of reflected clouds on the lake; set to 0 to hide

beach-turquoise.name: Maldives
beach-turquoise.desc: Turquoise water and pale beige sand, with schools of little fish swimming between dark coral reefs

fishSchools.label: Fish schools
fishSchools.hint: Number of dense fish schools swimming in deep water; set to 0 to hide

palms.label: Coconut palms
palms.hint: Number of coastal palms; 0 to hide. Fewer appear if there is not enough sand.

sigma.label: Distance from icons
sigma.hint: How far the shoreline sits from your icons

warp.label: Winding coast
warp.hint: How much the shoreline twists and turns

shoal.label: Clear shallows
shoal.hint: How wide the see-through water over the sand is

shallow.label: Shallow sea
shallow.hint: The distance from pale mint shallows to deep turquoise

turtles.label: Sea turtles
turtles.hint: Slowly swimming sea turtles; set to 0 to hide

beach.name: Beach
beach.desc: The shoreline curves around your files as waves roll up the sand

palms.label: Coconut palms
palms.hint: Number of coastal palms; 0 to hide. Fewer appear if there is not enough sand.

sigma.label: Distance from icons
sigma.hint: How far the shoreline sits from your icons

warp.label: Winding coast
warp.hint: How much the shoreline twists and turns

shoal.label: Clear shallows
shoal.hint: How wide the see-through water over the sand is

shallow.label: Shallow sea
shallow.hint: How far the water fades from turquoise to deep blue

sky.name: Sky
sky.desc: A cartoon blue sky where your icons sit on puffy round clouds — day, dusk or night

time.label: Time of day
time.hint: Follow the clock: dawn at 6:00, day at 7:00, dusk at 17:30, night at 19:00

sigma.label: Cloud size
sigma.hint: How far the clouds spread out from your icons

cover.label: Clouds in the sky
cover.hint: How many clouds drift across the open sky

flow.label: Drift speed
flow.hint: How fast the clouds drift and their puffs change

plane.label: Plane
plane.hint: A little plane trails across the top of the screen

moon.label: Moon
moon.hint: The moon and moonlight at night

stars.label: Star size
stars.hint: Stars at night; turn it up for bright stars with cross-shaped sparkles

ocean.name: Ocean
ocean.desc: Looking down on a blue ocean — your icons hide in white clouds whose shadows fall on the sea

sigma.label: Cloud size
sigma.hint: How far the clouds around your icons spread out

cover.label: Clouds over the sea
cover.hint: How many clouds drift over the open sea

flow.label: Drift speed
flow.hint: How fast the clouds drift and their puffs change

boats.label: Sailboats
boats.hint: White and gray sailboats sailing slowly across open water

yachts.label: Yachts
yachts.hint: White and gray yachts with dark gray windows, pale gray seats and foamy wakes

birds.label: Seabirds
birds.hint: White gulls gliding and circling over the sea

meadow.name: Meadow
meadow.desc: A pen-and-wash meadow where your icons hide in white clouds that cast dark green shadows

sigma.label: Cloud size
sigma.hint: How far the clouds around your icons spread out

cover.label: Clouds over the meadow
cover.hint: How many clouds drift over the open meadow

flow.label: Drift speed
flow.hint: How fast the clouds drift and their puffs change

showBoy.label: Show boy
showBoy.hint: Show or hide the boy together with his kite

showCat.label: Show kitten
showCat.hint: The little black kitten resting on the grass

forest.name: Forest
forest.desc: Your icons sit in a clearing ringed by gouache cartoon trees swaying in the breeze

sigma.label: Clearing size
sigma.hint: How big the clearing around your icons is, and how far away the trees stand

wind.label: Wind
wind.hint: How much the treetops sway; 0 means no wind

birds.label: Birds
birds.hint: Mostly perched on treetops, now and then flying to a nearby tree — they stay in the woods

pinkforest.name: Pink Forest
pinkforest.desc: A watercolor forest: translucent pink treetops on fine ink trunks

sigma.label: Clearing size
sigma.hint: How big the clearing around your icons is, and how far away the trees stand

wind.label: Wind
wind.hint: How much the treetops sway; 0 means no wind

birds.label: Birds
birds.hint: Little ink birds, mostly perched on treetops, now and then flying to a nearby tree

map.name: Hand-drawn City
map.desc: A bird's-eye map of an old town: rows of ink-drawn houses line the streets, and your icons sit in the squares

sigma.label: Square size
sigma.hint: How big the open squares around your icons are

canals.label: Canals
canals.hint: How many canals cross the town, with little boats drifting along

citymap.name: Colorful City
citymap.desc: An illustrated city map with red roofs and yellow, pink and blue walls; your icons sit in the squares

sigma.label: Square size
sigma.hint: How big the open squares around your icons are

worldmap.name: Old Map
worldmap.desc: A parchment continent: icons become seas, dotted roads link towns, and horse-drawn wagons carry supplies between them

sigma.label: Sea size
sigma.hint: How much sea surrounds your icons

ships.label: Sailing ships
ships.hint: Three-masted ships bobbing on the sea

wagons.label: Trade wagons
wagons.hint: Wagons carry crates and grain sacks between towns; set to 0 to hide them

nauticalmap.name: Nautical Chart
nauticalmap.desc: A parchment sea chart with coastal ports and lighthouses, winding sea routes, sailing ships and hand-drawn sea monsters

sigma.label: Land size
sigma.hint: How far the land extends around your icons

ships.label: Sailing ships
ships.hint: Hand-drawn galleons, schooners and cutters gently bobbing between the islands
